current_milestone.title: Expressive Capability
current_milestone.active_objective: SHEESH_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_UPSTREAM_SPATIAL_RUNTIME_001 now has a Researcher-only exact canonical source-pair contract, verified by 565 tests. The controlled restart passed RESEARCHER and RIG_DESIGNER, then stopped at POSITION_DESIGNER after three bounded attempts: invalid JSON, a non-object coordinate_system, and missing required fields. The next acceptance condition is a valid Position artifact from the same fingerprinted snapshot, followed by the unchanged Lighting Designer/Critic/Finalizer path. MA2 writes remain disabled.

last_closed_task.result: Read-only current Show snapshot completed. Scan-derived fingerprint b41d801b915cddfdd5017df787ad66b55941fbce415ab02ee8ec63acaa027bd5; 57 fixtures, 6 fixture types, 7 Groups, 65 subfixture geometry records, 27 Presets, 7 Sequences and 2 Executors. Geometry numeric XYZ/rotation is readable. No ZEN design roles ran and MA2_WRITES=0. Current runtime does not accept the fresh snapshot as first-class input and has no autonomous upstream spatial role before LIGHTING_DESIGNER.

next_acceptance_gate.why_it_matters: The Researcher canonical-source blocker is resolved: the controlled restart passed Researcher and Rig Designer, but Position Designer did not produce an artifact accepted by its existing schema validator after three bounded attempts. Downstream lighting design cannot run truthfully without a validated Position artifact.
dependencies: live current Show snapshot under the local experiment run
existing multi-agent runtime and provider router
next_acceptance_gate.next_review_condition: A Position Designer artifact for the exact current Show fingerprint passes existing required-field, fixture-reference, and finite-coordinate validation; then continue Lighting Designer, Critic, and Finalizer in order, preserving zero MA2 writes.

human_review_decisions.limitations: Authorization is limited to the fingerprinted current Test Show, this SHEESH/Stage View experiment and Agent-owned objects. It does not authorize Patch, Address, Fixture ID, Fixture Type, Fixture 9999, unrelated objects or production Show writes.
No numeric-ID tie-break, equal Group level, cohort saturation, Group participation count, or dimmer level may be promoted into Lighting Design knowledge or a production strategy.

evidence_results.limitations: Fingerprint confidence is PARTIAL rather than a native Show UUID. Stage/3D screen appearance was not captured. Numeric geometry is evidence only and carries no inferred artistic or stage-axis semantics.

Researcher and Rig Designer passed. Rig intent is not a per-fixture Position artifact; Position Designer failed JSON/schema validation after three attempts, so no placement is accepted and downstream roles did not run. Current-fingerprint fixture capabilities and coordinate-axis semantics remain UNKNOWN. Codex did not correct the Rig or Position content; no spatial writeback occurred.

This explicit Test Show authorization closes the resource absence blocker for SHEESH only. It does not establish a permanent palette, Group-to-Color role, B3 production authorization, or a Color design rule.
Fixture COLOR capability and generic typed CALL_PRESET syntax do not establish a current Show Color preset, applicability, palette, role, or B3 authorization.
